Account

Your plan renews on the first day of each month. You can change or cancel it at any time from the billing page, and any change you make applies from the first day of the month after.

Downloads are kept for thirty days, then removed from the server to save space; ask support to restore one.

The billing office answers by phone on weekdays from nine to five, Brasília time, and by email at any hour of the day or night.

Prices include taxes where the law requires them.
